title: Ajo on Ootle
creator: greatojies
summary: MIT-licensed rotating savings-circle template, CLI and walletless browser simulation. Every member contributes each round and receives one pot; a one-round deposit can cover a missed contribution. The creator documents template 3519aefd3d17e2bb88f061e1490a8107925381cf7c4af3f5911c4c1668e01b11 and the Uselu circle on Esmeralda. A November 17 read of the linked official testnet indexer returned the circle substate. The hosted browser page is explicitly a simulation. This is testnet evidence, not Ootle mainnet deployment. The recording shows the README and network-specific documentation.
cardSummary: Explore rotating savings circles, member deposits and scheduled payouts through an Esmeralda template and walletless browser simulation.
